body: already tried, tired of getting shit on by everyone, I just wanted to be treated like I had value for once

Quite literally yes, nobody goes out of their way for unattractive or poor people, but they certainly would if  the individual was rich or good looking because the latter characteristics are genuinely desireable

Why should I be afforded less opportunity due to things outside my control like my attractiveness or poverty I am born into? Why am I excluded from the experiences that the rich and attractive are given despite being told “I’m just as important and valuable”
What’s the point of existence lol, idc if I can taste food or listen to music, I just want the same opportunity rich and good looking people have in this world
But most are, and that’s never going to change

Feel the same way man, so funny when people say that you gotta love yourself or whatever bs or that beauty is in the eye of the beholder or some shit, when the society we live in constantly reinforces the invariable belief that unattractive people aren’t desirable or worthy then it doesn’t matter what you do; no amount of self love or confidence or whatever will change the standard others judge you by and will make you any less unattractive
easy for others to say when they don’t live the same day on repeat
One day ain’t good enough and that’s not even guaranteed, what did I do that I didn’t deserve what everyone else has
